summary: UI Testing for GREEN Selection States - All features pass. Doctor cards, clinic cards, calendar days, and time slots correctly display GREEN (bg-green-500) when selected and BLUE (bg-blue-500) when unselected. 'Selected' badge with checkmark appears on selected doctor/clinic cards. Full booking flow tested successfully.
context_for_next_testing_agent: GREEN selection states implemented successfully. Selection flow: BLUE (unselected/available) → GREEN (selected). Components verified: DoctorProfileCard (bg-green-500 when isSelected), ClinicCard (bg-green-500 when isSelected), RichCalendar days (bg-green-500 when isSelected), TimeSlotPicker (bg-green-500 when selectedSlot === slot), Selected Date info card (bg-green-500).

features_tested.feature: Doctor card shows GREEN background when selected, BLUE when unselected
features_tested.details: Dr. Vikas card changes from bg-blue-500 to bg-green-500 with shadow-green-200 ring-4 ring-green-300 when selected. Dr. Neha card remains bg-blue-500 when unselected.

features_tested.feature: Clinic card shows GREEN background when selected, BLUE when unselected
features_tested.details: Pushpa Clinic card changes from bg-blue-500 to bg-green-500 when selected. Amnion Clinic remains bg-blue-500 when unselected.

features_tested.feature: Time slot shows GREEN background when selected, BLUE when available
features_tested.details: Time slot 18:00 changes from bg-blue-500 to bg-green-500 with shadow-lg scale-105 ring-2 ring-green-300 when selected. Other available slots remain bg-blue-500.

features_tested.feature: Calendar day shows GREEN background when selected
features_tested.details: Calendar day (e.g., February 16) changes to bg-green-500 text-white shadow-md scale-105 when selected.

features_tested.feature: Selected Date Info card shows GREEN background
features_tested.details: The 'Monday, February 16, 2026 - 16 slots available' card displays with bg-green-500 background.

features_tested.feature: Selection badge shows green checkmark with 'Selected' text
features_tested.details: Badge with CheckCircle2 icon and 'Selected' text appears on selected doctor and clinic cards with white background and green text (text-green-600).

features_tested.feature: Full booking flow works: doctor -> clinic -> schedule -> verify -> confirm
features_tested.details: Successfully navigated through all 5 steps: Select Doctor → Select Clinic → Pick Date/Time → Patient Details → Continue to Book. All selection states properly show GREEN when selected.
